typed: parso mummy ka birthday hai, cake order karna hai. kya suggest karoge?

lastReply:
Parso, Sat 14 Nov, ke liye cake aaj ya kal, Fri 13 Nov, tak order kar do, taaki time par pahunch jaye. Kuch ideas:

Chocolate truffle: safe choice, lagbhag sabko pasand aata hai.
Fresh fruit ya pineapple cake: halka hai, agar mummy ko zyada meetha pasand nahi.
Photo cake: mummy ki pasandida photo cake par, personal touch ke saath.
Eggless butterscotch ya red velvet: agar ghar mein eggless chahiye ho.

Mummy ko kaunsa flavour sabse zyada pasand hai? Usi hisaab se main aage badhne mein madad karunga.
